summary: During my early years at DxD Applications & IT Solutions, I worked on maintenance and development projects involving Salesforce, REST integrations, Node.js services deployed on Heroku, Java web applications, and ETL processes with Talend. This stage allowed me to grow both as a developer and in my understanding of architecture, integrations, and cloud deployment.

Later, at Grupo Oesía, I worked first as a developer and later as a technical analyst on projects related to waste management and public administration. There, I took on responsibilities in architecture, full stack development, team support, and knowledge transfer, while also single-handedly managing the maintenance and evolution of an application for Zaragoza City Council.

At UST Global, I worked as a Software Full Stack Senior Analyst Engineer, playing a key role in the development of a hospital software solution using Angular and Node.js. During this period, I further strengthened my expertise in front-end architecture, state management, back-end development, code review, and collaborative work within demanding teams.

Since November 2021, I have been working as a Technical Lead at Adasa, leading initiatives related to water, environment, telemetry, monitoring, meteorology, document management, and public administration. During this stage, I have defined and overseen architectures based on Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, Flutter, Python, ThingsBoard, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitLab CI, OpenShift, Azure Functions, and authentication systems such as Keycloak/LDAP, always with a focus on scalability, traceability, and maintainability.

Throughout my career, I have taken ownership of key responsibilities such as defining the core architecture of projects, creating reusable starter templates, developing reference modules, defining the data model, implementing Docker and CI/CD pipelines, producing technical manuals, deployment guides and methodological documentation, as well as creating internal video tutorials and training materials to strengthen team enablement and knowledge sharing.

I currently work as a Technical Lead with end-to-end responsibility across projects, covering everything from architecture definition to final delivery. I act as the main technical point of contact, lead development teams, make key design decisions, and ensure the successful execution of solutions in real-world environments.

content: I have experience designing software architectures, web applications, mobile applications, data platforms, and IoT solutions, combining technical vision, execution capacity, and business orientation.
I have worked with technologies such as Java, Angular, React, Salesforce, Flutter, Node.js, Python, and ThingsBoard, both independently and as part of multidisciplinary teams.

My experience includes data modeling, full-stack development, base module design, creation of reusable templates, Docker containerization, CI/CD process implementation, and deployment in cloud environments such as OpenShift, Azure, and Heroku.
I have also contributed to the definition and management of database structures, establishing models, relationships, and integrations aimed at ensuring system integrity, efficiency, and evolution.
I promote an engineering culture based on Clean Code, SOLID, code reviews, testing, continuous integration, and technical documentation, strengthening team autonomy and technical quality.
